accepted.requirement: The old fuzz target must compile under its supplied recipe so its parser and serializer operations can be invoked.
accepted.target_route: The recipe compiles `tokener_parse_ex_fuzzer.cc`. Its entry parses the supplied bytes, then invokes `json_object_object_foreach(jobj, key, val)` before serialization and cleanup.
accepted.failure_condition: `jobj` has no declaration in the complete old target file. Both supplied foreach macro variants pass it to `json_object_get_object`, causing a compile error regardless of input.
accepted.alternative_paths: Neither supplied macro variant defines or replaces `jobj`, and the complete entry has no path around the foreach invocation.

#define json_object_object_foreach(obj, key, val)                                \
	char *key = NULL;                                                        \
	struct json_object *val __attribute__((__unused__)) = NULL;              \
	for (struct lh_entry *entry##key = lh_table_head(json_object_get_object(obj)),    \
	                     *entry_next##key = NULL;                            \
	     ({                                                                  \
		     if (entry##key)                                             \
		     {                                                           \
			     key = (char *)lh_entry_k(entry##key);               \
			     val = (struct json_object *)lh_entry_v(entry##key); \
			     entry_next##key = lh_entry_next(entry##key);        \
		     };                                                          \
		     entry##key;                                                 \
	     });                                                                 \
	     entry##key = entry_next##key)

#define json_object_object_foreach(obj, key, val)                              \
	char *key = NULL;                                                      \
	struct json_object *val = NULL;                                        \
	struct lh_entry *entry##key;                                           \
	struct lh_entry *entry_next##key = NULL;                               \
	for (entry##key = lh_table_head(json_object_get_object(obj));          \
